name: arsenal
description: A menu for the tool mods in this repo and for your own commands: a button in the footer under the prompt box opens a menu pane, docked on the right, with a Prompt Upgrade switch, a Sound notifications switch and sound picker, one-press shortcuts to /prompt-upgrade and /work-report, and USER and PROJECT sections listing your own skills and commands, each of which you can turn off. A remote control for the tools, with one thing of its own: the sound notifications.
